相见难，别亦难，       It’s difficult to meet and hard to part,
怎诉这胸中语万千？     How can I pour out the grief in my heart?
我柔情万种，           My tenderness ten thousand times in vain
他去志更坚，           Tried but failed to my love from going detain.
只怨今生无缘。         What can I do but of my life’s regret complain?
道不尽声声珍重，       Bidding him farewell again and again,
默默地祝福平安，       Wishing him at heart to be safe and sound.
人间事常难遂人愿，     Alas, how many perfect things in one’s life could be found,
且看明月又有几回圆？   And how many times one could enjoy the moon full and round?
远去矣，远去矣，       He goes away, O far far away,
从今后梦萦魂牵。       But for ever haunting my dream and soul he’ll stay!
